data.title: Mufti of Akkar Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Beirut, November 19, 2026, SPA -- Mufti of Akkar in the Lebanese Republic Zaid Bakkar Zakaria condemned the terrorist Houthi militia's attacks on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including the targeting of Makkah, calling them a blatant violation of the sanctity of Islam's holy sites and of all religious and humanitarian values.
    In a statement, he said the attacks were so heinous that words of condemnation fell short, likening them to the Zionist assaults on the Palestinian people.
    He said the aggressors' schemes would rebound on them and that oppressors and those who spread corruption would inevitably meet ruin. He expressed hope that the Kingdom and the region would enjoy lasting security and stability.
    -- SPA
